entities.name: Network-initiated NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the network initiates transport of NAS messages to the UE.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message sent by the network to the UE.

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: Information element containing the actual NAS message payload to be transported.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State where the UE is registered with the 5G network.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the DL NAS TRANSPORT message.
The DL NAS TRANSPORT message contains the payload container IE.
The procedure requires the UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
